title: Product Sans / Product Lockups
slide_intent: Test the face with real names so letter spacing and word rhythm can be assessed in the intended branding context.
strategic_value: Consistent treatment of Gmail, Search, Calendar and Drive can connect separate products within Google’s identity.
demonstration: Four oversized white product names form a centered vertical stack on red, with a lower-left note about kerning for lockups.
practical_value: Compare spacing across names with different letter combinations before assuming a single isolated word proves the typeface works.

content_islands.name: Product-name stack
content_islands.spec: Center Gmail, Search, Calendar and Drive in four large lines.

content_islands.name: Kerning rationale
content_islands.spec: Place the small explanation at lower left below the names.

reference_purposes.Intent: The caption explains that the typeface is kerned to support product names in lockups at different sizes.
reference_purposes.Expression: The four real names demonstrate the face’s rhythm.
reference_purposes.Application: The specimens test Product Sans on named Google products.
